scenario.topic: Select the core readings for a graduate artificial intelligence course

options.name: Classic Foundations and Theoretical AI Texts
options.upside: Provides comprehensive background on AI principles and foundational algorithms.
options.concern: Older texts may lack coverage of recent AI developments and applications.

options.name: Recent Advances and Machine Learning Focus
options.upside: Includes up-to-date research and practical machine learning techniques.
options.concern: Less emphasis on classical AI theories and symbolic reasoning.

options.name: Balanced Mix of Theory and Practice
options.upside: Covers a broad spectrum including ethical considerations and practical examples.
options.concern: Moderate length may limit depth in some specialized topics.

options.name: Application-Oriented Readings with Case Studies

attrs.focus_area: real-world AI applications and case studies

options.upside: Focuses on practical AI implementations and industry case studies.
options.concern: Less coverage of theoretical foundations and algorithmic details.

shared_context: A group of six faculty members must select core readings for a graduate artificial intelligence course. The readings should cover foundational theories, recent advancements, and practical applications within a manageable total length.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a senior AI researcher specializing in foundational algorithms and theoretical models.
personas.private_goal: Ensure students gain a deep understanding of AI principles and historical context.

A.reason_for: Provides comprehensive background on AI principles and foundational algorithms, which aligns with my focus on theory.

B.reason_for: Includes up-to-date research and practical machine learning techniques.
B.reason_against: Less emphasis on classical AI theories and symbolic reasoning, which I find essential.

C.reason_for: Covers a broad spectrum including ethics and practical examples, offering a balanced approach.
C.reason_against: Moderate length may limit depth in foundational theory.

D.reason_for: Focuses on practical AI implementations and industry case studies.
D.reason_against: Lacks theoretical foundations, which is a key priority for me.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a professor focused on integrating ethical AI practices with theoretical knowledge.
personas.private_goal: Select readings that balance theory, applications, and ethical considerations for a holistic curriculum.

A.reason_for: Strong foundational concepts that support understanding AI ethics and theory.
A.reason_against: Older texts may not address modern ethical challenges sufficiently.

B.reason_for: Up-to-date machine learning techniques are important for practical relevance.
B.reason_against: Less focus on ethics and foundational theory.

C.reason_for: Balanced coverage including ethics and practical examples fits my holistic approach.

D.reason_for: Good for practical applications but lacks theory and ethics focus.
D.reason_against: Too narrow for a graduate core reading list.

personas.name: Zara
personas.background: Zara is a machine learning specialist passionate about recent AI advancements and applications.
personas.private_goal: Prioritize the latest research and practical machine learning techniques for student readiness.

A.reason_for: Foundational theory is useful but less relevant for current ML focus.
A.reason_against: Older texts lack recent advancements critical to my interests.

B.reason_for: Includes cutting-edge research and practical machine learning techniques.

C.reason_for: Balanced approach includes practical and ethical topics.
C.reason_against: Moderate length may reduce focus on latest ML details.

D.reason_for: Focus on real-world applications is valuable.
D.reason_against: Less theoretical depth and ML focus.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is an industry veteran emphasizing practical AI applications and case studies.
personas.private_goal: Choose readings that prepare students for real-world AI challenges and implementations.

A.reason_for: Foundational theory is important but less relevant for applied focus.
A.reason_against: Older texts lack practical application emphasis.

B.reason_for: Recent advances are useful but less focused on real-world case studies.

C.reason_for: Balanced content includes practical examples and ethics.
C.reason_against: Moderate length might dilute practical focus.

D.reason_for: Strong focus on practical AI implementations and industry case studies.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a pragmatic AI engineer focused on applied AI and industry relevance.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the course readings are concise and highly relevant to current AI applications.

A.reason_for: Foundational theory is less relevant for my practical focus.
A.reason_against: Too long and outdated for current industry needs.

B.reason_for: Recent techniques are useful but less applied focus.
B.reason_against: Lacks emphasis on real-world case studies.

C.reason_for: Balanced approach with some practical examples.

D.reason_for: Concise and focused on practical AI applications and case studies.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a mid-career AI faculty member interested in ethics and practical AI applications.
personas.private_goal: Select readings that integrate ethical considerations with practical AI knowledge.

C.reason_for: Balanced coverage including ethics and practical examples fits my goals.

D.reason_for: Practical applications and case studies are useful complements.
